newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Mid-air crash kills 13 in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Mid-air crash kills 13 in Brazil.

text.p: Two small aircraft crashed in mid-air at an airport in Brazil's southern Santa Catarina state on Sunday, killing all 12 passengers as well as one woman on the ground who died of a heart attack when one of the bodies fell on top of her, an airport spokesman said.

He said the two aircraft, one twin engine and one single engine plane, with 12 people aboard crashed at 980 feet (300 meters) altitude during celebrations marking the 55th anniversary of a local airport.
There were no survivors and one woman on the ground died of a heart attack when one of the bodies fell on top of her, the spokesman said.
He said the cause of the accident was not yet known, but it seemed that one of the aircraft came in for landing, but then continued to fly straight ahead, colliding with the other plane.
